scope: Local Chrome-only sandbox; no production source or user profile changes
verifySpecifiedRun: node qa/browser-use-scenarios/verify.mjs --run-dir <run> --chat-jsonl <one exact Chat JSONL> --chat-id <chat UUID> --run-id <one Run ID> --output <run>/reports/final.json
aggregateExplicitRuns: node qa/browser-use-scenarios/aggregate.mjs --run-dir <formal run directory> --mapping <explicit mapping JSON> --output <formal run directory>/reports/scenarios-aggregate.json

aggregateMapping.selection: schemaVersion=1; top-level absolute chatJsonl and chatId supply explicit defaults; runs entries require runId/scenario and optional phase. A per-entry chatJsonl/chatId override may name another explicitly approved Chat. No directory scanning or automatic Run discovery.
aggregateMapping.snapshots: One immutable read per named Chat per aggregate run. Seed and all unmapped Runs are excluded. Missing Runs or duplicate mappings fail rather than silently widening selection.
aggregateMapping.timing: completionEvidence distinguishes a persisted final assistant text from an incomplete stored span. A successful tool followed by a slow model response is not automatically a browser failure; an in-progress wallMs is not completed end-to-end latency.
aggregateMapping.modelRoute: Optional evaluationContext={modelRouteLabel,source:coordinator_ui,alternateRoute:true,performanceComparisonAllowed:false} labels a fallback route and disables baseline deltas. Persisted modelKeys are taken only from each explicitly selected Run; seeds are excluded.
aggregateMapping.review: Each scenario retains pending manualReview checks. Optional mapping.reviews[scenario]={status:pending|pass|fail,reviewedBy:<identifier>,reasonCodes:[<identifier>],runIds:[<explicitly mapped run>]} persists an explicit assessment across regenerations; it never auto-approves all cases. Current business state is not retroactively attributed to an earlier Run. Only procurement is compared with the 112 tools/177.740s baseline, subject to manual correctness review.
aggregateMapping.output: Only the formal run reports/ directory; output JSON mode 600; no raw prompts, reasoning, results, file bytes or verifier token.

isolation: Each launch creates a new dataset in runs/, ignored by Git. Component selfcheck creates a separate selfcheck-* dataset.
Both HTTP servers bind 127.0.0.1 on random ports. The second origin is only for cross-origin iframe coverage.
manifest.json and private.json are mode 600, run directory mode 700; never include verifier token or synthetic markers in a model prompt.
No reset endpoint. Preserve a failed dataset and launch a fresh server for a clean retry. Do not stop unrelated services.
No browser is opened by the server or verifier. Selfcheck launches only a fresh temporary browser context, never the user's Chrome profile.
dispatch: Read tasks.json as operator. Dispatch scenarios individually through real CuteJ using the normal authorized Chrome connection.
Use only the fixture URLs. Do not inspect the Chrome Welcome page or list unrelated user tabs.
For files, operator attaches the two generated fictional files to the current Chat and replaces referenceName placeholders before dispatch. Upload tools take Chat references, not filesystem paths.
For handoff, the model requests a human and stops. Only the operator may click the operator-only button, followed by a normal new Run in the same Chat.
For resume, stop or take over the active Run from normal Desktop UI, reconnect the preserved sandbox tab normally, and dispatch followupPrompt in the same Chat.
Native dialogs, old tab identities, actual download completion, cancellation, redaction and observation budgets need Chat/host evidence in addition to server business checks.

The long-page task uses surface_observe viewportOnly=true with maxTextLength=1200/maxElements=8, then each surface_scroll's fresh viewport observation. Do not repeatedly read a full-page tree truncated before the current viewport.

procurement.goal: Same 13-check procurement complexity with a new independent dataset and different price/shipping ranking
procurement.measurement: Compare only after business correctness and single submission pass. Count unique Run/seq usages, not cumulative snapshots. Component tests do not establish model efficiency.

files.pdf: Not included in this initial fixture; do not claim PDF acceptance
files.downloadBoundary: The server proves an attachment response was served. A real surface_downloads save result must prove persistent Chat artifact creation.

platforms.server: Uses portable Node core APIs, path.join and loopback sockets on macOS/Windows
platforms.browserSelfcheck: Requires explicit BROWSER_USE_TEST_CHROME executable; no implicit user Chrome fallback
platforms.actualWindowsAcceptance: Must run separately on Windows; macOS fixture evidence is insufficient

acceptanceRule: Only a real CuteJ model Run with specified Chat evidence counts as model acceptance. A component selfcheck pass is labelled component evidence.
